description: Declared mutants of the tools' guards for the framework (v8-tool-framework-shell; v8-tool-ui-editor-path-dialog-adopt and -shell-adopt add the dialog and command-line mutants): ui_editor and audio_editor, owned by the tool line. Run with docs/architecture/plans/time-threads-trace/scripts/run_mutations.py --catalog docs/tools/plans/v8/scripts/framework_mutations.json --build-dir <a tree with GYO_TOOLS=AUTO (ui_editor and audio_editor) and BUILD_TESTING=ON>. A mutant is killed only when its test run fails with the expected message. The framework's own mutants moved to docs/architecture/plans/framework-rework/scripts/framework_mutations.json (v8-framework-guard-ratchet).

mutants.what: ui_editor names the native SDL platform beside the framework's ImGui binding
mutants.expect: names GYO::PlatformSDLNative

mutants.what: An answer counts for whatever request is waiting, whatever its tag
mutants.expect: FAILED: a newer request makes an older answer stale

mutants.what: A Failed answer ends its request, so the fallback dialog's answer is dropped
mutants.expect: FAILED: the answer that follows a failure \(the fallback dialog\) still applies

mutants.what: Stop waiting keeps the request, so its late answer still applies
mutants.expect: FAILED: an answer after Stop waiting is ignored

mutants.what: Every request gets the same tag
mutants.expect: FAILED: every request gets its own tag

mutants.what: The editor applies an answer its dialogs marked as no longer awaited
mutants.expect: FAILED: a stale folder answer mounts nothing

mutants.what: The adapter marks every answer as awaited
mutants.expect: FAILED: an answer after the request ended is marked as not awaited

mutants.what: Exporting asks for an open-file dialog
mutants.expect: FAILED: exporting saves a file

mutants.what: A chosen path reaches the editor as a cancel
mutants.expect: FAILED: the fallback dialog's choice reaches the editor

mutants.what: The audio editor names nlohmann_json beside the framework's JSON binding
mutants.find: PRIVATE GYO::Audio GYO::Engine GYO::Os GYO::ToolFramework GYO::ToolFrameworkJson
mutants.replace: PRIVATE GYO::Audio GYO::Engine GYO::Os GYO::ToolFramework GYO::ToolFrameworkJson nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json
mutants.expect: names nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json

mutants.what: The export guard never finds a path inside the asset root
mutants.expect: FAILED: export rejects every path below the mounted app asset root

mutants.what: ui_editor's export no longer creates missing folders
mutants.expect: FAILED: valid document exports without a catalog

mutants.what: The audio editor no longer creates the clip's missing folders
mutants.expect: REQUIRE\( report.has_value\(\) \) is NOT correct
